programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1725

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1726

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1727
programme.desc: Noen våkner med ængst. Og når den rosa telefonen ringer, må det legges nye planer.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1728
programme.desc: En heksedoktor sjekker inn på hotellet og nye par blir dannet. Et hemmelig oppdrag setter flere av gjestene i fare.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1729

programme.desc: Ting må debriefes på frokosten, og en av jentene må ta et vanskelig valg. Hvor går Emil?

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1001
programme.desc: Ingrid bor på leilighetshotell med sine to barn, og er desperat etter å få en ny start, og skape et hjem sammen med familien. Småbarnsforeldrene Toril og Eivind vil ut av leiligheten sin i Oslo-gryta.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1002

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1004
programme.desc: Alenemoren Ragnhild og sønnen Julius sover i dag i køyeseng, og trenger desperat større plass. Christina og amerikanske Justin har mange krav på lista, og Karianne tar utfordringa på strak arm!

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1005
programme.desc: Samboerne Linn og Joakim bor i dag i drømmehuset, men det ligger på helt feil sted! Hans Christian møter Christine, som leter etter en ny leilighet med uteområde til katten sin.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1006
programme.desc: Christian skal selge leiligheten han har arvet, og Karianne får derfor en helt ny utfordring! Vi møter også tidligere deltagere og får bli med inn i deres nye leiligheter, hus og gårdsbruk.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 609

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 611

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 612

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 613

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 911

programme.title: Charterfeber After Beach: Episode 101

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1009

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1104

programme.title: Charterfeber

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1007
programme.desc: Tinas planer om å dra til OL blir utfordret når hesten hennes er med om en ulykke. Karina og Tina bestemmer seg for å invitere alle fruene på et spaopphold på et nytt hotell.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1008
programme.desc: Alle er travelt opptatt med juleforberedelsene. Det er Tina og familiens første ordentlige danske jul, og Janni har store planer om å arrangere en julelunsj for alle fruene på Vedbæklund.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1101
programme.desc: Amalie fyller år, og Janni arrangerer en overraskelsesfest for henne og de andre fruene, men hvordan blir det å samles igjen etter konflikten mellom Janni og Gunnvør?

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1102
programme.desc: Tina og Allan har bestemt seg for å skaffe en hund, og spesielt Louis blir positivt overrasket. I mellomtiden skal Karsten delta i et løp for veteranbiler.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3105
programme.desc: Magnus drar til Gävle for å bryte 30 år gamle Daniels mønster, når det kommer til å bruke penger han ikke har. Akkurat nå er det så ille at gjelden hans hver måned er høyere enn inntekten.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3106
programme.desc: Fembarnsfaren Martins pengebruk kjenner ingen grenser. Det meste han eier er kjøpt på kreditt, og nå har samboeren Jessica fått nok og meldt på samboeren på Luksusfellen.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3107
programme.desc: Luksusfellen besøker Magnus som lever uten strøm i hjemmet sitt, en prioritering han har gjort de siste månedene når pengene ikke har strekt til. Ettersom det blir kaldere om natten, risikerer huset nå å få kuldeskader.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3108
programme.desc: Philip begynte allerede i ung alder å tjene gode penger på jobben som selger. Men en dag mistet Philip jobben, og for å fortsette å opprettholde livet han var vant til, begynte han å ta opp lån.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3109
programme.desc: Cecilia har ikke nok kunnskap til å få orden på gjelden sin, som har hengt over henne i mange år. Men når hennes verste mareritt en dag blir til virkelighet, innser Cecilia at nå trenger hun virkelig hjelp.

programme.title: Bogus
programme.desc: Whoopi Goldberg, Haley Joel Osment, og Gerard Depardieu har hovedrollene i denne hjertevarme komedie-fantasy-filmen som utforsker fantasiens verden og dens helbredende krefter.

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Brad (Ben Stiller) lever et komfortabelt liv i et villastrøk i Sacramento sammen med sin godmodige kone (Jenna Fischer) og sønnen (Austin Abrams). Livet forandres da han blir gjenforent med sine gamle venner.

programme.title: Bakeriet på Portobello Road
programme.desc: Tre generasjoner kvinner må overvinne sorg, tvil og hvordan de kan hedre sin elskede Sarahs minne mens de legger ut på et eventyr for å etablere et bakeri i hjertet av London som er fylt med kjærlighet, håp og fargerike bakverk fra hele verden.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: Mennene i Bravo-kompaniet står overfor en kamp i oppoverbakke... opp Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: Street Kings
programme.desc: En knallhard kriminalbetjent blir trukket inn i et dødelig nett av sammensvergelser og forræderi. Når han beskyldes for drap oppdager han at han ikke kan stole på noen. Med Keanu Reeves og Forest Whitaker.

programme.title: Congo
programme.desc: Når en oppdagers leting etter en diamantgruve ender tragisk i Kongo, sender faren og lederen for operasjonen dr. Karen Ross inn i jungelen for å fortsette letingen... kanskje etter sønnen sin. Men definitivt etter diamantene.

programme.title: Proxima
programme.desc: Astronauten Sarah forbereder seg til et års langt oppdrag på Den Internasjonale Romstasjonen. I det siste oppdraget før ferden til mars, er det mye som står på spill, ikke minst privat. Eva Green spiller hovedrollen som Astronauten Sarah Loreau.

programme.title: Men Alle Vet
programme.desc: Penélope Cruz og Javier Bardem har hovedrollene i den to ganger Oscarvinnende regissøren Asghar Farhadi's intense drama, hvor hemmeligheter og svik kommer til overflaten i en idyllisk spansk landsby.

programme.title: Guilty By Suspicion
programme.desc: Denne fengslende historien gjenskaper Hollywoods beryktede ”svartelisteepoke”. Heksejakten er i gang, og regissøren David Merrill kan igjen få fart på karrieren ved å vitne mot venner som er mistenkt for å være kommunister.

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: Julia Jones jakter intenst på kjærligheten - alltid på feil sted- helt til hun slår kloa idrømmemannen. Men en slu eks, en fjertende katt og eksentriske svigers truer...

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: En kvinne reiser langrenn til California for å være sammen med sønnen etter at han bestemmer seg for å droppe skolen og bli surfer.

programme.title: Tamara Drewe
programme.desc: Den unge journalisten Tamara Drewe vender tilbake til sine røtter på den engelske landsbygda for å selge sitt barndomshjem etter at hennes mor dør. Hennes ankomst skaper mildt sagt en hel del uro i byen.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Louie Louie
programme.desc: Mary Jane sitter hjemme uten noe å gjøre, men får nye problemer da Cece avslører sine planer for å utpresse henne. SNC ansetter Marisol, en het, ny, ung latinererstatning.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Sparrow
programme.desc: Da Mary Jane fikk de knusende nyhetene om en kjær venns død, tvinges hun til å konfrontere sine livsvalg, håndtere familien og møte David.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Being Kara
programme.desc: Karas liv fortsetter å snurre ukontrollert. Samtidig hjelper en uinteressert og stadig sørgende Mary Jane Niecy md sin først jobb.

programme.title: The New Edition Story: Night Three
programme.desc: Da New Edition oppnår en suksess uten sidestykke, vil de endelig kunne legge alle uoverensstemmelser bak seg eller kommer deres uoppgjorte tvister til å føre til undergang?

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Storm Advisory
programme.desc: Andre stilles ansikt til ansikt med David hos Mary Jane. Samtidig er forandringer i gang hos SNC. Når et anker blir sparket uten avskjed, blir Mary Jane, Kara og Mark urolige for jobbene sine.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 207
programme.desc: Mark Mylow planlegger å tilbringe sitt utdrikningslag i skogen med Al Large, men han blir bitt av en huggorm.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 208

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 301
programme.desc: Martin mistenker at Louisa kan ha anemi. Tante Joan blir tvunget til å motta behandling fra Martin etter at hun nesten kjørte på noen.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 302
programme.desc: Bert Large forlater rørleggerfirmaet sitt til fordel for å drive en restaurant. Etter restaurantens åpning forekommer det flere tilfeller av matforgiftning.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 303

programme.title: Kampens regler

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: Den tidligere CIA-agenten Robert bor på et hemmelig feriested for tidligere spioner. Nå er hans sønn Paul havnet i trøbbel og trenger hans hjelp. Dessverre er ikke Pauls planer så hemmelige som livet til faren.

programme.title: Taken 3

programme.title: Wildfire: Friendship/Passion

programme.title: Wildfire: Commitment Issues

programme.title: Wildfire: Being Mrs. Junior

programme.title: The Love Boat: Message For Maureen / Acapulco Connection / Gotcha

programme.title: Forensic Files: Video Diary
programme.desc: When convenience store employee Wanda Mason is found dead, investigators find the entire murder has been caught on the store's security camera. But the image of the killer is so degraded it seems impossible to positively identify him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Knowledge
programme.desc: Police investigate a missing college girl and discover her double life: attending school by day and working as a call-girl by night. Her body is found and investigators find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Missing in Time
programme.desc: A woman is reported missing after a fight with her husband. Police suspect a man who reported a fire in his car. Two tiny drops of blood are found in the interior. Finally, a tiny clue inside the suspect's watchband helps solve the case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Missing Pearl
programme.desc: In 1991, Maine resident Pearl Smith goes missing after an argument with her husband, Bill Bruns. When investigators find a blood trail that leads to the couple's basement, police are sure they'll find the victim's body.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Man's Best Friend?
programme.desc: In 1989, 4-year-old April Loveless was found dead in the backyard of her Texas home. Her parents told police that she was attacked and killed by wild dogs. Investigators did not agree.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hand Delivered
programme.desc: In 1995, San Diego police are baffled by a pair of hands found in a dumpster. Through further investigation, they determine that the hands are those of missing person Don Hardin.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fire Dot Com
programme.desc: In 1996, a federal agency ruled that Terri Strickland had intentionally set the fire that killed her 17-month-old son, Josh Hinson. Using the then-emerging resources of the internet, Strickland undertook her own investigation.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Mistaken For Dead
programme.desc: In 1988, when a patient dies unexpectedly in the office of California neurologist Richard Boggs, police begin what they think will be a routine investigation. Soon they uncover a bizarre story of corpse stealing, fake identity and sexual perversion.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Evidence
programme.desc: One investigator's quick thinking helps him capture a shoe impression made in snow before the evidence melts away. The shoe leads investigators to Peter Benedict and Frank Lanoue, who are convicted of aggravated assault and robbery.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soft Touch
programme.desc: In 1992, 22-year-old Dawn Bruce is brutally murdered in her Virginia apartment. Investigators notice a blood smear on a pillow case that appears to have been made by one of the killer's fingers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Betrayed
programme.desc: On the day before Thanksgiving, a mother discovered her ten-year-old son was missing from his school. When a child of separated parents disappears, investigators first look at the family and divorced parents often suspect each other.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Instinct
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, a serial killer stalked lone victims in the dead of night, his hunting ground the suburbs of Washington, D.C., his target, anyone who owned a car.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Under Fire
programme.desc: A series of armored car heists and bloody shoot-outs shocked law enforcement. The brutal violence of the crimes suggested a motive more complex than greed. When the robbers started targeting police, the FBI took charge.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Killers
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Body Count
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder, at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their undoing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve, Get Him Out!
programme.desc: Kelly’s ex-husband Nikki continues to haunt her. He went to jail for killing her 2 week old son and is now dating her 18 year old daughter! Can Steve get Nikki out of their lives forever?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Mother in Denial
programme.desc: When ordinary people need help, Steve Wilkos is ready to answer the call. Watch as Steve helps ordinary people stand up for themselves and fight for what he believes in order to promote justice for all.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Mother's Rage
programme.desc: Three years later, Elizabeth still carries strong doubts about Manny's intentions with her family and her husband Rodney is caught in the middle. Is Manny innocent?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Mommy Hurt Me
programme.desc: Stephanie’s drug addiction led her to neglect and abuse her kids. Scott’s fiancée stepped up as a mother and Stephanie failed multiple drug tests, he doesn’t want her near the kids, but wants her to atone for her wrongs!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Who’s Hurting My Granddaughter?
programme.desc: Maria claims that her son’s ex Amy and her new boyfriend Brian are abusing and neglecting her granddaughter. But Amy says Maria is a racist and angry over raising her grandchild in a Hispanic home!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: What Happened to My Baby?
programme.desc: Baby Garrett died of an oxycodone drug overdose while in Sharon’s care. His mother Casey left him with Sharon so she could visit her husband Kenneth in the hospital. Who’s responsible?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Wait! Don't Read The Results Yet Steve...
programme.desc: Sharina thinks that Clarence is cheating on her because he’s always out late. Plus, Chrystal doesn’t want Earnie’s ex Tenyia to live with them just because she’s the mother of his child.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Sacrificial Lamb
programme.desc: When 13yr old PJ Grant is found dead from a single gunshot wound to the head, Kenda assumes it’s a suicide. When the physical evidence doesn’t add up, it opens the door to a world of possibilities.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Six Feet Under
programme.desc: Kenda finds the body of a bruised and battered young woman named Vicki Ross strangled. Kenda must sort through the endless suspicious characters in Vicki's past to find the elusive truth.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood From A Stone
programme.desc: A bystander receives a deadly head injury during a roadside altercation, but the stakes are raised when his body disappears from the scene. When a toddler is kidnapped for ransom Kenda joins forces with an undercover team in a desperate race against time.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Eyes of a Child
programme.desc: A loving, churchgoing grandmother is found stabbed to death in her apartment, leaving Joe Kenda to wonder what sort of monster could do such a thing.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: City Of Fear
programme.desc: When a spate of violent robberies spreads terror across the city, Kenda and the major crimes unit are called in to bring the masked gunman to justice.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Setup
programme.desc: Douglas Warren stumbles into a downtown bar with a gunshot wound to the neck and bleeds out on the floor. Kenda must conduct a risky sting operation and launch an interstate manhunt.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Beginning of the End, Apollo Gets Complicated & The End of Apollo
programme.desc: The Beginning of the End - After the first Moon landing the Apollo science program was about to start in earnest but people were losing interest. Apollo Gets Complicated - New technology is added that extends the reach of the Apollo program.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.desc: The Shuttle Program - The first re-useable spacecraft. The Challenger Disaster - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. Return to Space - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rays
programme.desc: Cosmic rays can tell us much about the universe. They are not simply another form of light, but carriers of information about powerful and unseen processes at work thousands or even millions of light years away.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Fermi Paradox
programme.desc: The Fermi Paradox asks the ultimate question: Given a few reasonable assumptions about the chance of life arising elsewhere in the universe and the distance between the stars, why has an alien civilization not presented itself?

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Gene Morrison – Fraudulent Forensics Expert
programme.desc: He faked his own credentials and netted $400,000 of taxpayers money, giving bogus court testimony and investigative services.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Stephen Klenczar – Bogus Barrister
programme.desc: Obsessed with boys toys, he posed as a barrister and claimed he worked for the British Government secret service.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: The Conman Kid – Aged Just 13
programme.desc: This 13-year-old pulled off almost half a million dollars worth of fraud, often selling goods that didn’t exist.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Juan Carlos Guzman-Betancourt – Globe-trotting Trickster
programme.desc: In 1993, a young boy made the headlines when he was found as a stowaway on a plane which had arrived in Miami.

programme.title: Courage in Red: VIP Protection (The Francophonie Summit)
programme.desc: With 66 countries in attendance, the Summit Francophone hosted the largest deployment of foreign dignitaries in Canadian history. We're given special access to RCMP security measures at the Francophonie Summit where dangerous threats abound.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries: Episode 5
programme.desc: This episode includes: D.B. Cooper Parts 1 & 2, Update: Math Teacher Escape, Friends to the End & Update and Babe's Uniform & Update.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Time Travel
programme.desc: A lawyer and from the Pacific Northwest claims to have been part of a secret government time travel experiment, known as Project Pegasus.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Rendlesham Forest UFO Incident
programme.desc: Richard travels to England to investigate Britain's Roswell, also known as the Woodbridge-Bentwaters UFO incident, considered by many to be one of the best documented UFO cases on record

programme.desc: Richard speaks with several independent researchers about the efforts of international bankers to control the course of history and enslave humanity through their monopoly of the creation of money and the manipulation of the money supply.

programme.desc: Could vampires be real? A well-known U.S. paranormal investigator and folklorist in New York City recounts the legend and evolution of the vampire throughout history and from culture to culture.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Roswell UFO Crash
programme.desc: Richard speaks with the pre-eminent investigators of the alleged crash of a UFO near Roswell, New Mexico in 1947.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Death of Princess Diana - Tragic Car Accident or Murder Most Foul?
programme.desc: An investigation into the various conspiracy theories revolving around the tragic death of Diana, The People's Princess, in Paris in August 1997.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Secret Space Program
programme.desc: Were the Mercury, Genesis, Apollo and Space Shuttle programs mere window dressing designed for public consumption?

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Werewolves
programme.desc: The legend of the werewolf throughout history and in various cultures is explored. The Conspiracy Show travels to England and rural Wisconsin to investigate claims of actual werewolf sightings.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Mill Street Barracks
programme.desc: Built in 1861 Mill Street Barracks is steeped in rich history. It has accommodated many branches of the armed forces throughout its life. Like many other barracks it has also been used as a morgue making it a prime location for the supernatural.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World

programme.desc: Freddie stjeler uheldigvis Gibbys kjæreste, og Gibby blir sint. Så han udfordrer ham til kamp, og Freddie finner ut at han er en dyktig kickbokser. I mens selger Spencer kunsten sin, samtidig som han later som han er død for å tjene mere penger.

programme.title: iCarly: Lewberts tapte kjærlighet

programme.title: iCarly: Missekonkurransen
programme.desc: Sam avslører overfor Carly og Freddie at hun deltok i skjønnhetskonkurranser som liten. Da hun finner ut at hennes rival skal konkurrere i Seattle, overbeviser hun Carly om å stille opp mot henne.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi avlyser ikke
programme.desc: Etter at Sam plutselig må i fengsel, lover Carly og Freddie dyrt og hellig å ikke avlyse nettshowet ettersom faren hennes skal se det. Carly ber Spencer om hjelp, men det blir vanskelig, for han skal på date.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi avlyser ikke
programme.desc: En eksentrisk millionær ber Carly og vennene hennes om å sende det første nettshowet fra det ytre rom, så de må prøves ut for en romreise. Imens besøker en merkelig liten pike Spencer hjemme i leiligheten.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg tror på Bigfoot
programme.desc: Seattle får Bigfoot-feber når noen turgåere filmer en uskarp video av en mistenkelig figur ute i skogen. Etter at en ekspert verifiserer at opptaket er ekte på webshowet, overtaler Carly gjengen om å kjøre ut dit i Sockos bobil for å bli med og lete.

programme.desc: Jennas første kavaler til Homecomingballet roter opp gamle skyldfølelser rundt jenta hun en gang var og jentene som ikke har kavalerer.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En utfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til å eksponere seg offentlig, og dermed konfronteres hun med noen alarmerende og nye innsikter i sin person.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Etter en sen kaffe med Collin klarer ikke Jenna å slutte å tenke på ham, eller hva det betyr å være forelsket og det å ha en kjæreste.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Spenningen stiger mellom Jenna og Matty når Collin inviterer henne til en snerten fotovisning hjemme hos ham selv.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Etter å ha klint med Collin på impuls, bestemmer Jenna seg for å slutte å være utro før Matty finner ut om det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Hva skjedde egentlig på overraskelsesfesten - og er det virkelig helt slutt mellom Jenna og Matty? Det vet bare de to, men vennene deres prøver å finne ut sannheten.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna holder grillfest for at hennes venner skal venne seg til tanken på hennes og Collins spirende forhold. Men når deres støtte uteblir, tar hun drastiske midler i bruk.

programme.title: Awkward: The Bad Seed
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt uvenner med Tamara og Ming, syns Jenna at det ikke spiller noen rolle hva hun gjør lenger - og hun havner i en vanskelig situasjon.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val ber Mr Harts klasse om å skrive og framføre et eget skuespill, og moralen i historien virker svært kjent.

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Etterdønningene etter Jennas krangel med vennene gjør at hun går ut en kveld. Men det som skulle bli en kveld for å lette på trykket blir en kveld hun må reddes fra.

programme.title: Corporate: Casual Friday
programme.desc: Matt og Jake strever med å overbevise en kollega om å ha på seg en penskjorte på Casual Friday, og Christian prøver å spikre en avtale med flere megakirker.

programme.title: Corporate: The Long Meeting
programme.desc: John og Kate må overta ansvaret for et møte når Christian må ta en telefon, og holder igjen de ansatte på konferanserommet uten mobilene deres til de er ferdige med å brainstorme.

programme.title: Corporate: Society Tomorrow
programme.desc: Når de ansatte blir som besatt av en populær tv-serie, motstår Jake forsøk på å tvinge ham til å se den, mens Matt liv begynner å etterligne hendelsene i serien.

programme.title: Detroiters: Hog Riders
programme.desc: Etter at en klient inspirerer Tim og Sam til å jobbe mindre og leve mer, kjøper de en motorsykkel i stedet for produksjonsbilen de trenger, så setter de bort jobben sin til bygningens overivrige (og ukvalifiserte) vekter, Ned.

programme.title: Detroiters: Happy Birthday Mr. Duvet
programme.desc: Sam sliter med å komme på en verdig tale å holde på sin fars 60-årsdag. Tim er opprømt over at en klovn som har fri er på stedet og presser ham til å opptre likevel.

programme.title: Detroiters: Dream Cruise
programme.desc: Når de ansatte truer med å slutte på grunn av manglende helseforsikring, forsøker Tim og Sam å samle inn pengene de skylder fra tidligere jobber. Deres innsats forvanskes av Detroits årlige 'Dream Cruise'-bilshow. Gjest er Cecily Strong.

programme.title: Workaholics: Front Yard Wrestling

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3201

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3202

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3203

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3204

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soft Touch
programme.desc: In 1992, 22-year-old Dawn Bruce is brutally murdered in her Virginia apartment. Investigators notice a blood smear on a pillow case that appears to have been made by one of the killer's fingers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Disappearance
programme.desc: In 1981, 6-year-old Cassie Hansen disappeared from her Minnesota church during an evening service. After receiving a tip that an older man was seen carrying a small person, police found Cassie's body in a dumpster.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Photo Finish
programme.desc: Professional photographer Charles Rathbun claims model Linda Sobek died during a consensual sexual encounter gone wrong, but Sobek's corpse and digital imaging tell a more sinister story.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Whodunit
programme.desc: In 1998, a Maryland murder mystery performance turns into a real whodunit when the badly burned body of Stephen Hricko is discovered in his hotel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Horse Play
programme.desc: In 1980, Michigan resident Shannon Mohr died in what her new husband, David Davis, reported to be a horseback riding accident. After her death, Shannon's family reported that Davis seemed far from grief-stricken.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treads and Threads
programme.desc: For 15 months, a serial killer was strangling prostitutes in Florida, then taunting police by leaving the bodies in plain sight. The only clues were a tire impression and some threads.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer's Cattle Log
programme.desc: When police in the Great Plains are called about a dead body, a background check on the victim leads them into a bizarre web of homeless drifters, cattle auctions and bad checks — all fronted by elderly couple Ray and Faye Copeland.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skin of Her Teeth
programme.desc: In 1994, a human skull retrieved from an Ohio pond reveals a ghastly crime. Markings on the skull indicate that the victim had been stabbed multiple times and that the teeth had been removed with needle-nose pliers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Line of Fire
programme.desc: In 1996, when a fundamentalist group begins robbing banks near Spokane, authorities know immediately that they are dealing with experienced criminals.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Blood
programme.desc: In rural Canada, Dr. John Schneeberger is accused of sedating and sexually assaulting one of his female patients and his step daughter. DNA tests demonstrate that the doctor is innocent, but the patient insists that he sedated and raped her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pure Evil
programme.desc: In the search for the killer of two Texas teenagers, a behavioral profile led to suspect Jason Massey. Hard science proved the profile was correct, and Massey was executed by lethal injection on April 3, 2001.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Under Fire
programme.desc: A series of armored car heists and bloody shoot-outs shocked law enforcement. The brutal violence of the crimes suggested a motive more complex than greed. When the robbers started targeting police, the FBI took charge.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Global Pursuit
programme.desc: In Langley, Virginia, a terrorist fired into rush hour traffic. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political, targeting employees of the Central Intelligence Agency.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Identity
programme.desc: When a theft is committed, something valuable is stolen. But when a criminal needs a new identity, theft becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Hidden Obsessions
programme.desc: In San Diego, California, a killer has left behind pieces of evidence. Detectives must sort through these small clues to prove murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Error
programme.desc: Accidental deaths, suicides, disappearances, and fires; they're an everyday part of an insurance investigator's life. But cases shouldn't be taken at face value. Forensics has become a tool for exposing insurance fraud.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lasting Impressions
programme.desc: No matter how chaotic or how clean a crime scene appears to be, the culprit is bound to leave something telling behind. Occasionally, it's nothing more than a fingerprint or shoe tread. Sometimes that's all that's needed.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Wait! Don't Read The Results Yet Steve...
programme.desc: Sharina thinks that Clarence is cheating on her because he’s always out late. Plus, Chrystal doesn’t want Earnie’s ex Tenyia to live with them just because she’s the mother of his child.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Is My Husband the Abuser?
programme.desc: Joyia is desperate to keep her friend Stephanie from going back to her problematic ex Scott. But she still loves him! Will she have the strength to leave him?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Outraged!
programme.desc: Jack is worried about his grandchildren because his daughter-in-law Carol has been negligent and hot-tempered. Then, Kendra explains why she suddenly put Corey’s baby up for adoption.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Murder My Daughter?
programme.desc: Teenager Megan lives with her older controlling boyfriend Rick. Megan cannot attend school, find a job, or even eat without his OK! Can her aunt and Steve get through to her?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Fake Your Pregnancies?
programme.desc: Dennis claims his ex-girlfriend Kendal keeps tied down with pregnancy lies! He wants to know if their daughter is even his! Will Steve’s DNA test results finally let them move on?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Results Revealed: Did She Cheat?
programme.desc: Justin is convinced that girlfriend Lainie has been cheating on him, and more importantly that he’s not the father of their child. But his own insecurities have led him to turn violent. Also, Steven doubts whether Ashley’s child is his.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Setup
programme.desc: Douglas Warren stumbles into a downtown bar with a gunshot wound to the neck and bleeds out on the floor. Kenda must conduct a risky sting operation and launch an interstate manhunt.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Dead Weight
programme.desc: A seemingly random attack leaves Mary Moebus dead, and police flummoxed by a daunting field of suspects. But when Lt Joe Kenda uncovers a cache of new evidence, he realizes someone’s been lying.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Lady in Red
programme.desc: A woman in red drops a dying man off at a firehouse… and then vanishes. Identifying the mystery woman is the hurdle Kenda must overcome in order to bring him justice.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Follow the Money
programme.desc: The body of a 72-year-old man is found in a junkyard, stabbed 13 times and wearing nothing but his underwear and dentures.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Drive Thru Murder
programme.desc: Missy Berry is found dead in an idling car at a deserted intersection. A surprise twist in the investigation leads him into uncharted territory.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: The Truth is in the Stars
programme.desc: Does our society have the capacity to live up to Star Trek's optimistic vision for humanity's future? William Shatner takes us on a journey to find out whether art has imitated life in the years since the world-renowned TV series premiered in 1966.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot
programme.desc: Soviet Luna 3 was the first to use gravity to change course to photograph the dark side of the Moon. NASA Mariner 10 used the technique to swing by Venus to target Mercury. The gravity sling shot maneuver has become a standard for space navigation.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living Planet
programme.desc: We have been observing Earth for 40 years now, in the last 20 we have focus with intensity on the planet with new technologies and capabilities, we have accumulated a mass of data that is now revealing a complex and ever changing living planet.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Cosmic Collisions
programme.desc: Space is vast, yet it is full of collisions. Gas and dust electrostatically flock together, and gravity takes over coalescing grains into rocks. Those rocks become boulders, then asteroids colliding again and again, striking planets and each other.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity keeps us on the ground and the planets in their orbits, yet we only notice it when it's not there. In space we cheat gravity; falling just as fast but missing the ground. Now this fundamental universal force is slowly giving up its secrets.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Courage in Red: VIP Protection (The Francophonie Summit)
programme.desc: With 66 countries in attendance, the Summit Francophone hosted the largest deployment of foreign dignitaries in Canadian history. We're given special access to RCMP security measures at the Francophonie Summit where dangerous threats abound.

programme.title: Courage in Red: VIP Protection
programme.desc: A new group of students try to make the grade in the RCMP’s prestigious National VIP protection program.

programme.title: Courage in Red: Customs and Excise (Counter Smuggling)

programme.desc: They are iconic weapons: the Tommy Gun, Uzi, and today’s MP5. Invented to break WWI stalemates, the submachine gun revolutionized warfare and culture. Host Wil Willis explores its evolution, firing the Thompson and BAR.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Good Collaborators?
programme.desc: Finland defended itself in the Winter War under Marshal Mannerheim. Finland allied with Nazi Germany against the Soviet Union in 1941. Finland later negotiated peace with the Allies and switched sides as Nazi defeat became apparent.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Vidkun Quisling
programme.desc: Vidkun Quisling, once honored for diplomacy, turned traitor by collaborating with Nazis. His bid for power in Norway failed, relegated by Germans. Despite being named "fuehrer," his reign led to repression until his hanging post-Nazi defeat.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Artillery, "The King of Battle," has shaped history from ancient cannons to today's M777 Howitzer. Host Wil Willis visits Fort Sill, Oklahoma, to witness modern artillery like the M777 and M109 Paladin in action.

programme.title: iCarly: Ja
programme.desc: Etter at en iCarly fan frir til kjæresten på nettshowet, blir gjengen nesten tvunget til å gå i bryllupet. Men når bruden får kalde føtter, må Carly komme til unnsetning.

programme.title: iCarly: T-skjortesalg

programme.title: iCarly: Rampestreker
programme.desc: Når hun blir ertet for aldri å ha funnet på en morsom spøk, rekrutterer Carly Spencer for å spøke med Sam og Freddie. Men etter at Spencer har fått sansen for det, kan han ikke slutte. Mob må finne en måte å stoppe ham på.

programme.title: iCarly: Moren til Sam
programme.desc: Etter å ha kranglet ned moren sin, flytter Sam inn til Carly, som snart innser at hun er en fryktelig gjest. Freddie blir forfulgt av en farlig kriminell etter å ha fanget ham på film da han begikk en forbrytelse.

programme.title: iCarly: Nevel trenger hjelp

programme.desc: Det er på tide at Jenna kommer inn på rett spor igjen, men hun har forårsaket mer skade for sine nærmeste enn det som kan rettes opp med litt PR. Vil de tilgi henne, eller må hun ta i bruk drastiske midler?

programme.title: Awkward

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments

programme.title: Awkward: Prank Amateurs

programme.desc: Jenna forårsaker en ulykke på skolen som får overraskende følger. Samtidig må Matty håndtere konsekvensene av konfrontasjonen med Jake.

programme.title: Elton John MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In this MTV Unplugged Special, one of the most extravagant rockstars hits the stage. This is Elton John Unplugged.

programme.title: Workaholics: Dorm Daze
programme.desc: Når gutta drar på jobbmesse på North Rancho College, krangler Ders med Kystvakten, mens Adam og Blake prøver å oppfylle sine drømmer et annet sted på campus.

programme.title: Workaholics: Gramps DeMamp is Dead
programme.desc: Adam og hans far risikerer alt for å gi Gramps en ekte DeMamp-begravelse.

programme.title: Comedy Central Stand-Up Presents Jo Firestone
programme.desc: Jo Firestone emphasizes her love of yogurt, reveals what it's like to hook up with a stranger and gauges her audience's embarrassment level.

programme.title: Comedy Central Stand-Up Presents Solomon Georgio
programme.desc: Solomon Georgio details his experiences as an immigrant in the U.S., reveals his obsession with "Harry Potter" and explains what it takes to make it onto his enemy list.

programme.title: Another Period: Lillian's Wedding
programme.desc: Lillian vil gifte seg med en rik olding, Laverne. Gnistene flyr mellom Hortense og Lavernes kjekke barnebarn Bertram. Etter at avslørende bilder truer Fredericks stilling som visepresident, forviser han Beatrice fra Bellacourt Manor.

programme.title: Another Period: The Duel
programme.desc: Når Dodo mottar skilsmissepapirer, drar hun tilbake til Bellacourt for å ordne opp i sakene og utfordrer Chair til duell. Etter Lavernes død drukner Lillian sine sorger i alkohol, noe den nylig døpte Beatrice misliker sterkt.

programme.title: Corporate: Weekend
programme.desc: John presser Jake og Matt til å hjelpe ham med å flytte et gulvur i leiligheten sin, og saboterer deres planer for helgen.

programme.title: Corporate: Remember Day
programme.desc: Matt bearbeider familietraumer ved å ta helt av på kontorets julefest, Christian setter spørsmålstegn ved sitt verdenssyn, og Jake vurderer å forlate bedriften.

programme.title: Detroiters: Husky Boys
programme.desc: Tims far - 'Big Hank' - kommer uventet tilbake fra galehuset under mistenkelige forhold. Tim og Sam sliter med en å skape et slagord for en varehus-reklame som henvender seg til store, sterke karer.

programme.title: Detroiters: Quick Rick Mahorn in Dearborn
programme.desc: Tim og Sam oppdager at Chrysler-sjefen de kjørte over har hatt det forferdelig siden. Etter å ha vært med i en av reklamene, får Piston-legenden Rick Mahorn skuespillerambisjoner. Gjester er Jason Sudeikis, Rick Mahorn og Richard Karn.

programme.title: Workaholics: Wolves of Rancho
programme.desc: Gutta overføres til en annen avdeling på TelAmeriCorp for å jobbe for en karismatisk leder.

programme.title: Broad City: The Lockout
programme.desc: Når Abbi får sprøytet leiligheten sin mot skadedyr og Ilana mister nøklene sine, blir jentene nødt til å bo på gaten - akkurat når Abbi har sin første kunstutstilling.

programme.title: Broad City: P*$$Y Weed
programme.desc: Jentene må bli voksne! Abbi vil kjøpe sin egen marihuana, som en voksen kvinne, mens Ilana må takle skatten på egen hånd. Og, jentene er høye som hus.

programme.title: Broad City: Fattest Asses
programme.desc: Når Abbi innser at hun er for snill, blir hun mere bitchy. Ilana bestemmer seg for å nå sitt fulle potential. De går på en eksklusiv fest og møter noen eventyrlige DJ-er. Nå kan ingenting gå galt.

programme.title: Broad City: Hurricane Wanda
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana klarer sig igennem stormen med hjælp fra deres venner (Jaimé, Lincoln og Jeremy), men de får desværre selskab af Bevers og hans søster. Et spil 'Who Done It?' udspiller sig, mens orkanan raser udenfor.

programme.title: Broad City: In Heat
programme.desc: Ilana leter febrilsk etter en gave i siste øyeblikk til Lincoln, mens Abbi prøver å finne et klimaanlegg for å få det kjølig på soveværelset.

programme.title: Broad City: Mochalatta Chills
programme.desc: Der dukker opp nye muligheter når Abbi endelig kan trene noen på Soulstice og Ilana gjør suksess som firmasjef.

programme.title: Broad City: Wisdom Teeth
programme.desc: Abbi skal trekke visdomstennene og Ilana ser det som sin plikt å passe henne til hun får det bedre - noe som selvfølgelig innebærer en masse 'medikamenter' og en total mangel på tilsyn.

programme.title: Broad City: Knockoffs
programme.desc: Abbi og Jeremy går på en date som ender med en overraskelse. Ilana og hennes mor leter etter den perfekte håndvesken.

programme.title: Broad City: Hashtag FOMO
programme.desc: Jentene leter etter den perfekte fest, noe som avslører en underlig og surrealistisk side av Abbi, som igjen bekrefter Ilanas verste anelser.

programme.title: Broad City: Citizen Ship
programme.desc: Gjengen skal feire at Jaime har blitt amerikansk statsborger, men Bevers fører Abbi og Ilana på avveier med å love dem gratis sprit. Imens må Lincoln og Jaime klare seg selv blandt alle advokatene.

programme.title: Broad City: Coat Check
programme.desc: Abbi prøver å finne en forsvunnet frakk, mens Ilana utforsker en ny romanse - som føles merkelig kjent.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Garcia's Secret Girlfriend
programme.desc: Dangle and the gang solve Reno's biggest mystery: who is Garcia's new girlfriend?

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Son
programme.desc: While Dangle spends time with a beautiful young man who might be his son, the other deputies enjoy the new department Humvee.

programme.title: RENO 911!: CSI: Reno
programme.desc: The deputies work as security guards when "CSI: Miami" comes to Reno, and Wiegel and Dangle get a homeless man into a bathtub.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Naked Stake-Out

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel and Craig Get Married
programme.desc: Good news and bad news for Wiegel: her boyfriend proposed, but he's going to be executed for multiple murders.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel's Pregnant
programme.desc: Did Dangle and Garcia freeze to death? Did Wiegel's serial killer husband get lethally injected? What is Carrot Top doing in Reno, and why is he so mad?

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Junior Bros.
programme.desc: While Garcia goes undercover to bust undocumented workers and the people who hire them, Junior spends his day off with his brothers.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Jet Ski Blues
programme.desc: The Reno Sheriff's Department inherits a beautiful, cursed jet ski from a fallen deputy.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Rick's On It
programme.desc: Rick the Citizens' Patrolman one-ups the Sheriff's Department in investigating a crime spree, and Garcia receives a visit from an old, unpredictable friend.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Spanish Mike Comes Back
programme.desc: Spanish Mike Alvarez returns to tempt the deputies, and Jones and Garcia work security at a Ted Nugent concert.

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: The Love Contract & True Hollywood Stories: Rick James

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: The Internet & Moment in the Life of Lil Jon

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: World Series of Dice & Mooney on Movies
programme.desc: The Marcy Projects hosts a champion shooter contest, and Paul Mooney talks "Gone with the Wind."

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: I Know Black People & Keeping It Real Goes Wrong

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: Oprah's Baby Daddy & Jury Duty
programme.desc: Dave gets Oprah pregnant and recalls being a member of the O.J. Simpson trial jury.

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: Kneehigh Park & Making da Band
programme.desc: P. Diddy gives unusual requests, and Snoop Dogg visits Kneehigh Park; appearances by Q-Tip and Wyclef Jean.

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: Mandela Boot Camp & The Time Haters
programme.desc: Dave reveals sketches that are too hot for television.

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: Wayne Brady & Tyrone Biggums's Fear Factor

programme.title: School of Rock: Ville Jeg Løyet for Deg?
programme.desc: Det skal være talentshow på skolen men gjengen vil ikke såre Freddy ved å fortelle ham at sangen hans er elendig. Derfor lyver de, og må gjøre alt de kan for å redde Freddy fra den totale ydmykelse på scenen.

programme.title: School of Rock: Minstelønn
programme.desc: Summer vil ta seg jobb for å tjene penger til mobil, men det er Tomika som får jobben hun vil ha. Dette blir det uvennskap av. Freddy blir oppdaget av en modellagent, han ender opp som sengevæternes ansikt på plakatene.

programme.title: School of Rock: Et Spørsmål om Tillit
programme.desc: Bandets gamle fiende, Justin, dukker angrende opp på skolen, hvor han har fått jobb som vaktmester. Summer vil hjelpe ham, men er han til å stole på? Freddy leser Summers dagbok - tror han.

programme.title: School of Rock: Kul Greie
programme.desc: Tomika vil imponere den nye franske jenta for å bli invitert til partyet hennes. Hun lyver, og sier at hun kjenner bandet Hey Violet.

programme.title: School of Rock: Kjærlighetens Krigssone
programme.desc: Skolen skal sette opp Romeo og Julie, men Tomika er lei av det, og vil sette opp en rap-versjon av slaget ved Alamo - som noen mener er forbannet. Freddy har lagt sine egne planer for stykket.

programme.title: School of Rock: Overraskelse!
programme.desc: Forviklingene står i kø før romansen mellom Freddy og Summer. Forviklinger blir det også rundt en overraskelsesfest som arrangeres til Freddys bursdag.

programme.title: School of Rock: Du vet Ikke Hva du Har (Før fet er Borte)
programme.desc: Instrumentene blir stjålet, og gjengen lager loppemarked for å få inn penger til nye. Summer klarer ikke kvitte seg med noe, så Tomika selger en av bollene hennes for å få henne til å innse at hun ikke trenger minner i form av gjenstander.

programme.title: School of Rock: Bjelleklang-rock
programme.desc: Det er jul og Freddy savner moren sin. De andre prøver å muntre ham opp. Samtidig prøver Kale å overvinne sjenansen og bli med i juleforestillingen.

programme.title: School of Rock: La Oss Komme Oss ut Herfra
programme.desc: Dewey er deppa fordi iskremsjappen hans skal rives. De beslutter seg for å demonstrere mot rivningen. Men Dewey blir alene om å protestere fordi gjengen må delta på en akademisk tikamp.

programme.title: School of Rock: I Love Rock & Roll: Del I
programme.desc: Dewey vil spille på Austin Musikkfest, men forelskelsen mellom Freddy og Summer utvikler seg, og de to turtelduene ødelegger hele auditionen med sitt fjerne vesen. Dewey forlater School of Rock til fordel for sitt gamle band.

programme.desc: The true revolution won't occur until the crowds watching are reminded of the power of real Football and decide to take a stand. The Raimon Eleven welcome back members who had quit, and the regional championship match begins.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: The Autumn Sky Challengers!
programme.desc: The Holy Road tournament is finally underway. Surrounded by powerful enemies sent by Fifth Sector, the matches ahead will be the toughest yet. So the team practices harder than ever, reminding themselves that no opponent is unbeatable.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Gather, At The Flag Of Revolution

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: The Fearsome Cyclone Arena
programme.desc: The first round of the Holy Road tournament gets underway at Aerodrome Arena. The Raimon Eleven are put on the defensive by Lunar Sea (Military) Academy's formations and attacks, which take full advantage of special contraptions unique to the venue.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Revive Our Football!
programme.desc: Raimon uses Aitor and Gabi's stellar tandem skills to combat Lunar Sea's tactical play. When Arion uses his Fighting Spirit to even the score, momentum shifts to Raimon.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: He’s back!
programme.desc: Following in Aitor's footsteps, a new player tries out for Raimon. Coaches Evans and Sharp see his love for the game and readily accept him, and despite having only two months experience, he quickly integrates himself with the team.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: The Adversarial White Devil
programme.desc: Alpine has fallen under the control of Fifth Sector, and Raimon is tasked with rescuing them. Knowing that Alpine's stout defence can stand up against Thunderbolt, Raimon prepares a surprising new tactical play.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: J & Alice

programme.desc: Pepsi, a German Shepherd, becomes intensely aggressive around cats. Goldie, the beautiful Brittany Spaniel of “General Hospital” star Jacklyn Zeman that has become aggressive towards female dogs.

programme.desc: Nicky, a 4-year old black Rottweiler, suffered terribly in his youth. His new owner has given him a loving home. However, there are a few old habits he can’t shake, including dog aggression.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Percy & Justice
programme.desc: Percy, a West Highland White Terrier, is a handful, biting anyone who tries to touch his hindquarters. Justice, a Pit Bull, is slowly escalating toward dangerous aggression.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Stewart & Buddy

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Lucy & Lizzie

programme.title: Aliens Against Nuclear War: Edgar Mitchell
programme.desc: 12 moonwalkers claim ET visited Earth, govt covered it up. Aliens stopped nuclear war. Crazy or worth hearing more?

programme.title: UFO Hunters: Alien Fallout

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: The Alchemist

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Temptation
programme.desc: A beautiful attorney seduces Catherine's boss, Joe Maxwell, creating a serious conflict of interest.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Promises of Someday
programme.desc: Catherine is disturbed when she begins to suspect the new attorney in her office is a fraud... and more disturbed when she finds him looking for the entrance to Vincent's world.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Down to a Sunless Sea
programme.desc: Catherine fails to heed Vincent's warnings about her dangerous former law-school beau.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Fever
programme.desc: After Mouse discovers a ship's gold and gemstones treasure buried beneath the city, Vincent's community is torn apart by greed and strife.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Six Degrees of Freedom

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Gift

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Dummy

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Young Man's Fancy

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: I Sing the Body Electric

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Point of Origin

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Mary, Mary
programme.desc: A woman who lives with mannequins because she is unable to deal with real people gets a rude awakening.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Spirit Photographer
programme.desc: Despite the discouragement of his friend, a middle-aged photographer, Algernon, tries to captures spirits on film.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Moth

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: No Strings
programme.desc: A mobster who has finally defeated his old rival hires a reluctant puppeteer to string up his rival and make it dance for him. The mobster is unaware that puppet and puppeteer both have agendas of their own...

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Grave Robber
programme.desc: In this comedic episode, two treasure hunters discover a lost Egyptian tomb and accidentally revive a mummy. The mummy, Tapok, doesn't try to strangle them, but rather challenges the male explorer to a game of strip poker.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Yattering And Jack
programme.desc: A normal, everyday, plain-as-day man is plagued by a demon, the Yattering, but seems oblivious to its mischief.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Seymourlama
programme.desc: Much to his parents' frustration, a spoiled young boy, Seymour, is declared the High Lama by a group of monks.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Sorry, Right Number
programme.desc: Katie receives a mysterious phone call from a woman warning about her husband's death...but he isn't dead yet. Katie ignores the phone call, and her husband dies when she doesn't get him to the hospital in time.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Payment Overdue
programme.desc: Michael, a heartless collection agent, finds out that Jeanette doesn't quite understand the rules of going into debt, and has some unpleasant problems as a result.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Love Hungry
programme.desc: Betsy, an overweight woman, receives an anonymous package with an earpiece that will supposedly help her diet. It transmits the "voices" of her food as is being eaten, but Betsy still has problems.

programme.title: JAG: Black Ops

programme.title: JAG: Survivors
programme.desc: In a civilian court Harm represents a divorced (and emotionally baffled) Marine colonel, who has gotten into trouble over an unauthorized visit with his minor son.

programme.title: JAG: Recovery
programme.desc: A Navy astronaut dies during a drill while preparing for a space mission to repair a satellite

programme.title: JAG: Prisoner

programme.title: JAG: Ares
programme.desc: Someone kills a Naval officer on Okinawa, then his ship encounters major trouble during war games at sea

programme.title: The Love Boat: Romance Roulette / The Captain's Captain / Dog's Life

programme.desc: In a Christmas-themed cruise, the captain worries about how to effectively lead his ship but be a friend to his crew as well. A married couple who outwardly appear happy and in love are both desperate for the other person to give them a divorce.

programme.title: The Love Boat: The Old Man And The Runaway / A Fine Romance / The Painters
programme.desc: A crotchety old man and a teenage runaway form an unlikely friendship. Julie grows frustrated when an old friend of her brother's repeatedly rejects her advances without explanation.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Family Reunion / Cinderella Story / Too Hot To Handle
programme.desc: A woman who believes her departed dad was a noble sea captain forms an attachment for a devilish old purser; a newlywed couple are prevented by dislocated backs, sunburn, and even poison ivy from enjoying their honeymoon.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pure Evil
programme.desc: In the search for the killer of two Texas teenagers, a behavioral profile led to suspect Jason Massey. Hard science proved the profile was correct, and Massey was executed by lethal injection on April 3, 2001.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Root of All Evil
programme.desc: A suspect's former lover comes forward with a fantastic tale of murder, mutilation and cremation. But there's no way to test the story's validity — until a plant pathologist and a dendrochronologist conduct tests where the cremation supposedly occurred.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Where the Blood Drops
programme.desc: Susie Mowbray was charged in her husband's death. Her son was so convinced of her innocence that he enrolled in law school, studied all of the evidence and, eventually, discovered the truth of what really happened between his parents.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Punch Line
programme.desc: In 1994, Rhoda Nathan was found murdered in a Cincinnati hotel room. When hotel employee Elwood Jones visited the emergency room with an infected hand, which he said was cut on a dumpster, the doctor recognized the injury as something else.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sibling Rivalry
programme.desc: In 1991, San Francisco pornographer Artie Mitchell was murdered in his home. His brother and business partner, who was found near the scene carrying a rifle, later confesses to shooting Artie.The question is whether the shooting was premeditated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pastoral Care
programme.desc: In 1981, New York correctional officer Donna Payant disappeared and was later found in a landfill. The medical examiner not only identified the cause of death, but also found an important clue.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bagging a Killer
programme.desc: In 1999, 9-year-old Valiree Jackson vanished on her way to school near Spokane. Her father, Brad Jackson, reported the disappearance and the entire community started searching for her abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Trouble
programme.desc: In 1995, when off-duty Maine State Trooper Vicky Gardner is attacked by Steven Fortin during a routine stop, it triggers a chain of events which jumpstart a stalled murder case in New Jersey.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cats, Flies & Snapshots
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Lori Auker left her Pennsylvania home for work and never arrived, it took space-age technology, cat hairs and insects to pinpoint the woman's abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naked Justice
programme.desc: When Leann Fletcher is found dead, investigators use blood spatter analysis and forensic computing to find a motive for her murder: her husband, a prominent lawyer, was having an affair with judge Susan Chrzanowski.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Global Pursuit
programme.desc: In Langley, Virginia, a terrorist fired into rush hour traffic. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political, targeting employees of the Central Intelligence Agency.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Trail
programme.desc: The disappearance of young women triggered a search that spanned the Pacific Northwest. A massive media campaign failed to locate the drifter, who first charmed then killed them. As investigators followed his trail, he always stayed one step ahead.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Artillery, "The King of Battle," has shaped history from ancient cannons to today's M777 Howitzer. Host Wil Willis visits Fort Sill, Oklahoma, to witness modern artillery like the M777 and M109 Paladin in action.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution: Frenzied Killing
programme.desc: Flere mennesker blir drept i 1944 enn noen gang før på Auschwitz. Nazistene prøver å så forvirring blant de allierte i øst, og de vestlige allierte tar beslutninger om å forhandle med nazistene om jødene og bombe leiren.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Seizing Power
programme.desc: In 1930s Germany, Hitler capitalizes on economic woes blaming the Weimar Government and Jews. Despite scandals, Nazi rallies gain popularity and emerge as the largest party. Hitler becomes Chancellor in 1933, using the 'Enabling Act' to seize power.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees
programme.desc: Monty treks one of the toughest and most famous freedom trails out of Nazi controlled France, taking him through the valleys and high ridges of the Pyrenees mountains and into Spain.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game
programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Does Not Bite
programme.desc: Ballet byr på mange overraskelser.

programme.title: Awkward: Holding on and Letting Go

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1004
programme.desc: Alenemoren Ragnhild og sønnen Julius sover i dag i køyeseng, og trenger desperat større plass. Christina og amerikanske Justin har mange krav på lista, og Karianne tar utfordringa på strak arm!

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1005
programme.desc: Samboerne Linn og Joakim bor i dag i drømmehuset, men det ligger på helt feil sted! Hans Christian møter Christine, som leter etter en ny leilighet med uteområde til katten sin.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1006
programme.desc: Christian skal selge leiligheten han har arvet, og Karianne får derfor en helt ny utfordring! Vi møter også tidligere deltagere og får bli med inn i deres nye leiligheter, hus og gårdsbruk.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 901
programme.desc: Toppblogger Isabel Raad har tidligere leid leilighet for 29 000 kr i måneden. Nå skal hun kjøpe sin aller første bolig, men klarer Karianne å finne noe som kan leve opp til de skyhøye forventningene?

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 902
programme.desc: Amalie Snøløs drømmer om å kjøpe et oppussingsobjekt! Men har hun egentlig tid til det? Solfrid og André har spurt Hans Christian om hjelp til å finne drømmehuset, men ikke for enhver pris.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 623
programme.desc: Det blir høyt tempo på kjøkkenet og glohett rundt grillene før servering. Trude jobber hardt for å dra serveringen i havn, men er uheldig og faller når stresset tar overhånd.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 624
programme.desc: I lærlingkampen blir deltakerne testet i både teknikk og hurtighet, utfallet blir for mange overraskende og det er duket for årets mest spennende kokkekamp.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 625
programme.desc: Deltakerne går denne sesongens siste vanlige uke i møte med en restaurantsjef alle gleder seg over. Kjartan har store forventninger til de gjenværende deltakerne og har lagt lista høyt for den siste ukesmenyen.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 626
programme.desc: Både flammer og utmattelse setter kjepper i hjulene for prestasjonene denne uken. Kjartan må ta over kokkeleringen under dagens menysmaking for at deltakerne skal komme i mål.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 627
programme.desc: Mutta har visualisert hvordan han skal tilberede sin rett i raskt nok tempo, om han klarer å utføre planen gjenstår å se. Restaurantsjefen har et sterkt ønske om å komme seg til finalen og står hardt på for å klare det.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 904

programme.title: Charterfeber After Beach: Episode 106

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 916

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1018
programme.desc: Fred Åge og Sven Erik er på delfinsafari. Familien Haider tar turen til gocartbanen. Gjengen fra Radio Kvinesdal sliter med teknikken før live-sendingen, og Svein og Linni prøver å finne en karaokebar.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 917
programme.desc: Sommeren går mot slutten på Gran Canaria, og de ferieglade turistene prøver å få med seg mest mulig før hjemreise.

programme.title: Charterfeber
programme.desc: Familien fra Harstad er nok en gang på besøk på Gran Canaria. De får selskap av verdens gemeste fyr, Fred Åge og førstereisgutt Roger. Med er også Paradise Hotel-vennene Bendik Romeo, Lotte og Amalie.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 906
programme.desc: Med utsikt over Åsenfjord ligger et lite hyttetun bestående av 3 hytter. Her er det en storfamilie som ønsker seg et finere fellesområde utendørs, samt en oppussing av den eldste hytta.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 702
programme.desc: Denne gangen går turen til vakre Os utenfor Bergen. Hytta trenger sårt en stilforandring, og her får gutta virkelig vist seg fra sin kreative side. De snur opp ned på dagens planløsning og lager morsomme utemøbler.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 606

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 705

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2302

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2303

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2305

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2306

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Höga Kusten

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Uppsala

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: North Sealand

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: The Danish Lakelands

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: West Sweden

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Luleå

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naked Justice
programme.desc: When Leann Fletcher is found dead, investigators use blood spatter analysis and forensic computing to find a motive for her murder: her husband, a prominent lawyer, was having an affair with judge Susan Chrzanowski.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treading Not So Lightly
programme.desc: By using techniques she saw on forensic science TV shows, a mother determines who was responsible for the accident that permanently injured her 4-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shopping Spree
programme.desc: When a woman and her daughter didn't return home from shopping, her husband directed police to a nearby mall. The child's body was found, but there was no sign of the wife.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Forever Hold Your Peace
programme.desc: When Chris Ochoa confessed to the 1988 rape and murder of Nancy DePriest, the case was closed. 8 years later, Achim Marino confessed to the same crime. Can DNA evidence identify the real perpetrator?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Reel Danger
programme.desc: When two boys are brutally attacked, investigators rely on evidence fished out of a nearby pond. It became the first case where diatom analysis was used to place a suspect at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Who's Your Daddy
programme.desc: In 1988, the body of a young woman was discovered in an Ohio river. Most of the evidence had been washed away, but the victim's 6-year-old son unwittingly told investigators all they needed to know — without saying a word. The clue was in his genes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Alibi

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purr-fect Match
programme.desc: When police discovered the body of Douglas Beamish's estranged wife, authorities linked 20 cat hairs found on her jacket to a cat owned by Beamish's parents. It was the first time animal DNA was used to solve a criminal case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bio-Attack
programme.desc: When more than 700 Oregonians contracted food poisoning from a unique strain of salmonella in 1984, investigators uncovered a secret plot to influence local elections.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Shot in the Dark
programme.desc: Two sets of scientists probe a woman's death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Without a Prayer
programme.desc: In 1995, the founder of American Atheists disappeared with one of her sons, her granddaughter and $500,000 in gold coins. The police investigated several suspects, including David R. Waters, who worked for American Atheists.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Business

programme.title: The FBI Files: The C-11 Squad

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Vowes

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator

programme.title: The New Detectives: Elements Of Murder

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly intentions

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game
programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Hitler Strikes East
programme.desc: The German invasion of Russia from Operation Barbarossa on 22 June 1941 to Kursk on 5 July 1943.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Killer Police
programme.desc: In Ukraine and Lithuania, Nazi invaders were welcomed as liberators. In Lithuania, Antanas Gecas led a militia that executed hundreds of Jews. Ukrainian nationalists participated in pogroms slaughtering 34,000 Jews in two days.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: iCarly: Turen til Yakima
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt disset i et intervju om iCarly, prøver Freddie å vise sin kreative side gjennom å webb-sende iCarly i 3D. Spencer ansetter en assistent som han ikke har råd til å betale.

programme.title: iCarly: Tabber

programme.title: iCarly: Fortsatt like gal
programme.desc: Ettr å ha fått beskjed om at Nora Dershlit blir løslatt fra fengselet, ser iCarly-gjengen på hva de kan gjøre for å holde sin gamle kidnapper bak lås og slå. Imens oppdager Freddies mor den virkelige T-Bo.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly møter One Direction
programme.desc: Carly får en smittsom sykdom og kommer til å smitte et medlem i bandet One Direction. I mens skal Spencer trene en liten jente som ikke kan fordra å morsjonere.

programme.title: iCarly: Restauranten
programme.desc: Gibby åpner en hemmelig restaurant i skolens kjeller med Sams hjelp. Og Spencer designer en sikkerhetsrobot til hjemmebruk, som plutselig mister fokus helt.

programme.title: iCarly: Aprilsnarr
programme.desc: I dette spesielle aprilsnarr-avsnittet blir Carly og Spencer satt på gaten, så gjengen sitter og tenker tilbake på sin tid i Bushwell Plaza. Men minnene deres stemmer kanskje ikke alltid helt med hvordan vi husker hendelsene.

programme.title: iCarly: Dårlig stemning i butikken
programme.desc: Freddies nye drømmejobb i Pear Store blir et mareritt når Sam også blir ansatt. Imens prøver Carly å bli inviteret ut av en fra Pear Store, og Spencer må melde seg til frivillig jobb på den lokale brannstasjonen.

programme.title: iCarly: Halloween
programme.desc: iCarly-gjengen holder en "Halfoween"-fest, for de syns at det skal være Halloween to ganger i året. Men da en forkledd gjest spiller Carly og vennene et puss, blir festen litt for vill.

programme.title: iCarly: Chucks lillebror
programme.desc: Et sinna barn ønsker inderlig å hevne seg, men målskiven Spencer prøver iherdig å stoppe ham. Gibby blir knust når hans nye lekelaserpistol går i stykker, men blir fra seg av henrykkelse når Freddies reparsjion gir den overraskende krefter.
